query: A retail enterprise sells multiple dairy products. The company aims to maximize total revenue by optimizing order fulfillment under initial inventory limits provided in the ‘Initial Inventory’ column. Demand quantities are specified in the ‘Demand’ column and are assumed to be deterministic and known in advance. Decision variables x_i represent the number of units of each product i that will be fulfilled.

Maximize total revenue:

$$
\max \sum_{i \in I} A_i \cdot x_i

   $x_i \leq I_i$
